analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (106,365 KRW) vs SMA5 (107,483 KRW) / SMA20 (107,699 KRW) / SMA50 (106,646 KRW): below short-term/mid-term trends, indicating a neutral range position.
· Position relative to SMA100 (115,704 KRW) / SMA200 (94,801 KRW): weak mid-to-long-term trend dominance.
· 52-week position (56.4%) + current price level at a historical midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (56.0→48.3): continued sideways movement in the neutral zone, weakening pullback after exiting oversold.
· MACD histogram trajectory (874.1455→-79.9157): turned negative and showing improvement, suggesting potential bottoming.
· Bollinger Band current price position (107,699 KRW, middle band): consolidating near the middle band, lacking directional momentum.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (100,000 KRW): based on the 20-day low, acting as a psychological support.
· Swing resistance (110,910 KRW): below Pivot R1 (113,750 KRW), a short-term resistance zone.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: sideways, no trend reversal signal generated.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.84x): decreased confidence in price movement, indicating lethargic action.
· Current phase diagnosis: accumulation phase, maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to unmet entry conditions.
